name: Garruk Wildspeaker
description: Garruk Wildspeaker is a huge planeswalker druid and hunter who prefers a solitary life in the wilds and was cursed by Liliana through the Chain Veil.

summary.text: Garruk Wildspeaker is a huge planeswalker druid and hunter who prefers a solitary life in the wilds and was cursed by Liliana through the Chain Veil.

bio.text: Garruk turned his back on civilization long ago, preferring a solitary life in the wilds.
Liliana used the Chain Veil to infect him with shadow, after which he hunted her across worlds to Innistrad, seeking to make her lift his curse or take revenge.
On Innistrad he was captured in Odric's trap, weakened and cursed, and later Avacyn wanted him brought to her cathedral before the curse made him a demon.
Vronos hunted the corrupted Garruk, was overwhelmed by his beasts, and lost to him.
Liliana described how Garruk was becoming a monster, and Will later found a way to free him and win him over as an ally.
In the Reality Fracture, he agreed to help Chandra and Ajani in return for information on containment, joined Vraska's allies against the Theorist, and carried part of Jace in his head.
He blamed Liliana's curse for ruining him, but after learning she cared for the twins he spared her and planeswalked away.

status.text: As of the latest story, Garruk is alive and has planeswalked away after sparing Liliana.

timeline.summary: The creature identifies itself as Garruk Wildspeaker, weakened and cursed.
timeline.quote: "I'm weakened, cursed, and no threat to you," it said.

timeline.summary: Enraged, Odric smashes the pommel of his sword against Garruk's temple, dropping him.
timeline.quote: Odric bashed the blunt end of his sword against the monster's temple

timeline.summary: Grete pleads that the creature is not a werewolf and proposes bringing it alive to Thraben.
timeline.quote: "Let us bring it to Thraben—alive. Leave the days of slaughter behind us.

timeline.summary: Odric lets go of Garruk, sheathes his sword and orders him drugged and tied for the road to Thraben.
timeline.quote: "Drug him and tie him down.

timeline.summary: Vraska threatens Jace's allies and mentions Garruk Wildspeaker, hinting that something has happened to him, and tells Jace he is a plague.
timeline.quote: You're a plague, Beleren. A scourge to all those you claim to protect.

timeline.summary: Back at the Chamber, Lavinia reports the guilds now know of Vraska, and Jace, uneasy about Garruk, prepares to leave for a few days.
timeline.quote: And I think something's up with Garruk.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls her first visit, when she killed her horse's attacker and used the veil to infect Garruk with shadow, after which he hunted her to Innistrad.
timeline.quote: She'd used it to infect him with shadow, polluting his nature magic with the touch of death.

timeline.summary: Avacyn tasks Vronos with finding the cursed planeswalker Garruk and bringing him to her cathedral.
timeline.quote: You must find this man, Garruk, and bring him to my cathedral.

timeline.summary: Vronos confronts the corrupted Garruk and is overwhelmed by his beasts, then wounded in the shoulder by his thrown axe.
timeline.quote: Garruk had simply hurled his weapon.

timeline.summary: Vronos kills a doe for sustenance; Garruk finds him and swings his axe as Vronos bows his head.
timeline.quote: The axe whistled down. Vronos bowed his head.

timeline.summary: Liliana explains she is killing her demonic creditors, with two down, and describes the Chain Veil and how Garruk is becoming a monster.
timeline.quote: "Two down," she said, holding up two fingers and grinning. "Two to go."

timeline.summary: Will recalls that Kasmina's invitation came soon after Garruk left them on their own.
timeline.quote: her invitation had come out of nowhere, arriving only a few days after Garruk had been satisfied enough in their security to leave them on their own

timeline.summary: Loot draws maps for Vraska, and she sends Chandra and Ajani to recruit Garruk on Muraganda.
timeline.quote: If we want a chance at making our way to Jace, then we'll need Garruk's help.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Ajani find Garruk's lodge on Muraganda, guarded by tripwires, and he leads them in.
timeline.quote: This tower of muscles can only be Garruk Wildspeaker.

timeline.summary: Chandra explains that Jace's plan would overwrite the Multiverse, and Garruk says illusions don't smell real to him.
timeline.quote: "They don't smell real."

timeline.summary: Garruk agrees to help in exchange for information about wards, seals and magical containment.
timeline.quote: "I need people who understand wards, seals, magical containment.

timeline.summary: Vraska meets Chandra, Ajani and Garruk after they slog through ooze, and they argue about Liliana, whom Garruk wants revenge on.
timeline.quote: "Stand aside and permit me my revenge," Garruk says with deadly calm. "The witch cursed me."

timeline.summary: The four climb the tower and meet a woman in white who embraces Chandra and says she came willingly.
timeline.quote: "I don't need to be saved. I came willingly."

timeline.summary: Garruk, Ajani and Chandra expose the woman as not Liliana, and Vraska punches her unconscious.
timeline.quote: Vraska doesn't hesitate. She swings her legs over the desk and socks Liliana at the angle of her jaw.

timeline.summary: The allies chase through looping halls and burst into Opal's office, where hours have passed and they are injured with lost memories.
timeline.quote: When did I get in a fight ?

timeline.summary: Ajani speaks Greek, Garruk's muscles twitch and Chandra is lost, showing Jace's effects; Opal says they fought Jace three times.
timeline.quote: "Oh, sweetie. You fought Jace three times."

timeline.summary: Vraska and her allies burst into the sanctum and Garruk, Chandra and Ajani collapse asleep at the Theorist's snap while Vraska stays standing.
timeline.quote: The four of them burst into his sanctum, and half a second later, three hit the floor.

timeline.summary: Vraska tells him he is a killer who will murder billions, and he wipes her memory and sends the four out.
timeline.quote: her memory of the last few minutes is resting in the Theorist's hand.

timeline.summary: On the third attempt Vraska says he will not convince them, and the Theorist realizes he can command them instead.
timeline.quote: "I don't need to convince you, " he commands, dark and gentle.

timeline.summary: He orders the others to stop each other, and they fight until he calls it off.
timeline.quote: "Stop the others from stopping me."

timeline.summary: The Theorist disables Chandra's decision-making, ruins Garruk's muscles and steals Ajani's language.
timeline.quote: The Theorist reaches inside Ajani's mind and snatches away an entire language.

timeline.summary: Vraska realizes they only fought the Theorist, the worst part of Jace.
timeline.quote: "That's not Jace," Vraska concludes with a sick roil of her guts. "It's just what's left."

timeline.summary: Tam heals the injured allies, restoring Garruk's muscles and Ajani's speech.
timeline.quote: Her eyes light up with blue, and after a long minute, both Chandra and Garruk relax.

timeline.summary: Chandra's cryomancer double appears and attacks the group with ice, and the allies jump out the window into the courtyard.
timeline.quote: "Dad says hi," says her double

timeline.summary: Doubles of Ajani, Garruk and Vraska arrive, and Vraska guides Chandra in a blind fight.
timeline.quote: "It's my double! It takes a few seconds for petrification to charge.

timeline.summary: The allies fall into the tower's memory traps and find a marble plain with a well.
timeline.quote: It's an infinite plane of marble, endless and bare, with what looks like a well at the center of it.

timeline.summary: In a lecture hall they find the number of beings in the Multiverse on a chalkboard and meet the Detective, an aberration of Jace.
timeline.quote: Jace steps through, but not the one from upstairs.

timeline.summary: The Detective asks the others to find the rest of his parts and hold them in their minds until they can be unified with the Theorist's body.
timeline.quote: You'll need to find the rest of me.

timeline.summary: Garruk volunteers to carry part of Jace in his head, while Chandra refuses.
timeline.quote: "I will," Garruk grunts.

timeline.summary: The group sees an illusion of Elesh Norn, compleated Nissa and compleated Jace; Chandra and Ajani charge, but Garruk warns it is illusion.
timeline.quote: Ahead, in a massive room at the base of a massive tree, is Elesh Norn, gargantuan and gleaming, straddling the great roots of Realmbreaker.

timeline.summary: The World Tree booms and knocks everyone down; Garruk holds back Ajani as they escape through a portal.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexian World Tree pulses with light, and an immense boom from somewhere inside of it knocks them all to the floor.

timeline.summary: They emerge on Zendikar and decide to follow the portals; Garruk senses Eldrazi illusions.
timeline.quote: "Eldrazi are near. More illusions of them, anyway."

timeline.summary: Walking into the Singing City, the group's minds fill with telepathic noise from the voices of others and each other.
timeline.quote: This memory trap is the sensation of not being able to shut out the voices of other minds!

timeline.summary: Garruk kneels by the young Jace, who does not know who he is, and promises to protect him; the boy vanishes into Garruk's mind as the Clean Slate.
timeline.quote: "I will protect the child."

timeline.summary: The sphinx rises again, and the nightmare compels Garruk to jump off the ledge.
timeline.quote: Garruk draws his axe and lurches forward to swing but suddenly knows he needs to turn around

timeline.summary: Garruk, Ajani and Chandra reach the portal, but Vraska, compelled by the sphinx, steps off the edge of the building.
timeline.quote: And as easily as one would step off the last stair, she steps over the edge.

timeline.summary: The aberrations vanish from his mind and the heroes rush him, but he freezes them in place.
timeline.quote: The heroes rush the Theorist. Without a second thought, he flicks his hand, and his friends come to a halt, standing perfectly still.

timeline.summary: The Theorist summons portals and his friends' doubles tackle them into the portals, then he weaves the two Multiverses together.
timeline.quote: Each tackles their twin into a different portal.

timeline.summary: The friends beat their doubles, Garruk knocks down the cryomancer, Ajani rips away the Chain Veil, and Chandra sends fire.
timeline.quote: roaring as he rips the ancient artifact away with a swipe of his claws.

timeline.summary: Vraska, in her double's disguise, stabs the Theorist in the heart with a knife while Chandra, Ajani and Garruk emerge from a portal.
timeline.quote: Something sharp pierces the Theorist's heart, and he gasps.

timeline.summary: Jace gives each of his friends a final message, and Liliana forgives him.
timeline.quote: Liliana smiles. I'm sorry, Jace. Rest unburdened.

timeline.summary: The tower fades, and the doppelgangers of Chandra, Garruk and Ajani step out of a portal and attack.
timeline.quote: One of the portals in the center of the sanctum glows, and out step their doppelgängers.

timeline.summary: Garruk blames Liliana's curse and asks if she knows the twins; she says she cares for them, and he planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: "I will not forgive you, witch, but tell me the truth and I will spare you. Do you know the twins?"

timeline.summary: Garruk turned his back on civilization long ago, preferring a solitary life in the wilds.
timeline.quote: Garruk is a towering mountain of a man who turned his back on civilization long ago, preferring a solitary life in the wilds.

relations.quote: this affliction will transform him into a demon beyond any other

The beastmage you cursed is still hunting you

Garruk says the witch cursed him and wants revenge.

relations.quote: The druid's axe clatters to the ground, his fingers too weak to hold it.

relations.note: Garruk blames her curse for ruining him.
relations.quote: "Your curse ruined me," the druid snarls.

pages_say.description: A planeswalker, weakened and cursed with black veins and a werewolf-like appearance, captured in a net by Odric's trap.
A planeswalker whom Jace fears he has failed and whose fate Vraska hints at.
A nature-magic planeswalker whom Liliana infected with shadow and who hunted her across worlds to Innistrad.
A planeswalker cursed with a blight of death magic, a huge corrupted brute who summons bears, defeats Vronos and hunts him.
A Planeswalker who is turning into a monster after fighting Liliana over the Chain Veil.
A cursed beastmage who is hunting Liliana and killing Planeswalkers as he follows her trail.
One of Liliana's unresolved issues, tied to the Chain Veil.
Left the twins to their own security shortly before the invitation arrived.
A figure whom Will freed and won over as an ally.
A huge planeswalker druid and hunter living in a lodge on Muraganda, who can smell through Jace's illusions and agrees to help for information about containment.
A huge planeswalker druid and hunter who wants revenge on Liliana and detects Opal's deception by smell.
A huge planeswalker druid whose muscles the Theorist makes spasm and weaken.
A planeswalker druid weakened by the Theorist who finds his double has embraced the Chain Veil.
A hunter and druid planeswalker who volunteers to carry part of Jace in his head and recognizes illusions.
A planeswalker druid who joins the assault on the Theorist.
A druid planeswalker who fights the cryomancer Chandra and joins the final fight.
A druid planeswalker who blames Liliana's curse for ruining him, then asks about the twins and spares her.
A towering planeswalker huntsman and tracker who prefers a solitary life in the wilds and enlists beasts as allies.
